cases.name: Nicoleon "Nikki" Marie Reed
cases.about:
"Nikki was a good girl," said Larry Trent. He said he'd often sit on his porch with Reed and listen to her share stories about her struggles and problems on Independence Avenue.

He said Reed called him "Pops," and said he was one of the few people she trusted.

"I feel sorry for her because the poor girl didn't have nobody else to go running to," he said. "Nobody else wanted to sit and listen to her."

cases.narrative: He stated he strangled her with a belt for 10 minutes. He dumped her by the side of the road with her shirt pulled up and pants down and poured bleach on her body.
